## What was created

- **`artifact-cleanup.sh`** — reads a mock artifact inventory (TSV: id, name, size, ISO-8601 creation date, workflow run ID) and applies three retention policies in order: `--max-age-days` deletes anything older than the limit, `--keep-latest N` keeps only the N newest artifacts per workflow group, and `--max-total-size` then evicts the oldest survivors until the retained total fits the budget. It prints a `DELETE`/`KEEP` plan with a per-artifact reason, a machine-parseable `SUMMARY: retained=… deleted=… reclaimed_bytes=… retained_bytes=…` line, and supports `--dry-run` (no deletions) vs apply mode, where "deletion" writes to a `--deleted-log` file — the seam where a real GitHub API call would go. A `--now` flag injects the clock for deterministic tests, and bad input (missing file, malformed rows, non-numeric values) produces line-numbered errors with exit code 2.

- **`test/artifact_cleanup.bats`** — 17 tests written strictly red/green: five cycles (CLI contract → max-age → keep-latest → size budget → summary/dry-run/apply), each demonstrated failing before the implementation made it pass. Fixtures live in `test/fixtures/`.

- **`.github/workflows/artifact-cleanup-script.yml`** — triggers on push, pull_request, nightly schedule, and workflow_dispatch; `permissions: contents: read`; a `lint` job (bash -n + shellcheck) gating a `test` job via `needs`, which runs the full bats suite plus four delimited scenario cases with a pinned clock so output is byte-exact.

- **`test/workflow.bats`** — structure tests: actionlint exits 0, expected triggers/jobs/dependency exist, and every path the workflow references exists on disk.

- **`run-act-tests.sh`** — stages a temp git repo with the project and fixtures, runs `act push --rm`, appends the delimited log to `act-result.txt`, and asserts act exit 0, both jobs succeeded, the in-pipeline bats suite reported `1..17` with no failures, and exact expected values per case (e.g. the combined scenario must show precisely `retained=2 deleted=3 reclaimed_bytes=6000` and deletion-log entries `1 ci-logs-old`, `2 ci-logs-new`, `4 ci-bin-old`). I bundled all four cases into one act invocation since runs were budgeted at three; only one was needed.
